templates.pat: While we try to provide as much documentation as possible about our site, we may overlook certain topics of interest. If you can't find the answer to your question listed in our support pages below, please email us at: {{1}} and we will answer your question directly. Our site is constantly changing so please check back often for possible changes.
templates.zh: 尽管我们尽量为本站提供尽可能完整的文档，但仍可能遗漏某些关注话题。如果在下面的支持页面中找不到你问题的答案，请发邮件至 {{1}}，我们会直接答复你的问题。本站内容不断更新，请经常回来查看可能的变更。

templates.pat: COVID-19 is a rapidly evolving global health crisis and the research community is expediting release of new publication datasets on SARS-CoV-2 to facilitate new therapeutic approaches. At the BioGRID, we're focusing our curation efforts on the literature for these data, and making any datasets we curate openly available on our {{1}}, {{2}}, and {{3}} for easy access by the global research community.
templates.zh: COVID-19 是一场快速演变的全球卫生危机，研究界正加快发布 SARS-CoV-2 的新文献数据集，以推动新的治疗途径。在 BioGRID，我们正把整理工作集中在这类数据的文献上，并将整理出的数据集公开在{{1}}、{{2}}和{{3}}上，方便全球研究界取用。

templates.pat: If you're looking for Coronavirus health information, please visit your local government resources or see what the health experts at {{1}} and the {{2}} are recommending. Stay safe and help flatten the curve!
templates.zh: 如果你在寻找冠状病毒健康信息，请访问当地政府资源，或参考{{1}}和{{2}}的健康专家给出的建议。注意安全，帮助压平疫情曲线！

templates.pat: BioGRID is a biomedical interaction repository with data compiled through comprehensive curation efforts. Our current index is version {{1}} and searches {{2}} publications for {{3}} protein and genetic interactions, {{4}} chemical interactions and {{5}} post translational modifications from major model organism species. All data are {{6}} provided via our search index and available for download in many standardized formats.
templates.zh: BioGRID 是一个生物医学相互作用数据库，其数据通过全面的整理工作汇编而成。我们当前的索引版本为 {{1}}，可检索 {{2}} 篇出版物中的 {{3}} 项蛋白质相互作用与遗传相互作用、{{4}} 项化学相互作用，以及来自主要模式生物物种的 {{5}} 项翻译后修饰。所有数据均通过我们的检索索引{{6}}提供，并提供多种标准化格式供下载。

templates.pat: The BioGRID Open Respository of CRISPR Screens (ORCS) is a publicly accessible {{1}} compiled through comprehensive curation of all genome-wide CRISPR screen data reported in the biomedical literature. ORCS is updated on a quarterly basis and is fully searchable by gene/protein, phenotype, cell line, authors, and other attributes. Each screen recorded in ORCS is accompanied by structured metadata annotation that captures salient CRISPR experimental details. All data in ORCS can be downloaded in standard formats.
templates.zh: BioGRID 开放的 CRISPR 筛选库（ORCS）是一个可公开访问的{{1}}，其数据通过全面整理生物医学文献中报道的所有全基因组 CRISPR 筛选数据汇编而成。ORCS 每季度更新，可按基因/蛋白质、表型、细胞系、作者等属性完整检索。ORCS 中记录的每项筛选都附带结构化元数据注释，用来记录关键的 CRISPR 实验细节。ORCS 中的所有数据都可以按标准格式下载。

templates.pat: The {{1}}'s curated set of data have been updated to include interactions, chemical associations, and post-translational modifications (PTM) from {{2}} publications. These additions bring our total number of non-redundant interactions to {{3}}, raw interactions to {{4}}, non-redundant chemical associations to {{5}}, raw chemical associations to {{6}}, Non-Redundant PTM Sites to {{7}} and Un-Assigned PTMs to {{8}}. {{9}}{{10}} New curated data are added in curation updates on a monthly basis. For a more comprehensive breakdown of our numbers, check out our latest {{11}}. To download these data, visit our {{12}} or utilize our {{13}}.
templates.zh: {{1}} 整理的数据集已更新，新增了来自 {{2}} 篇出版物的相互作用、化学关联与翻译后修饰（PTM）数据。这些新增使我们的非冗余相互作用总数达到 {{3}}，原始相互作用达到 {{4}}，非冗余化学关联达到 {{5}}，原始化学关联达到 {{6}}，非冗余 PTM 位点达到 {{7}}，未分配 PTM 达到 {{8}}。{{9}}{{10}}新增整理数据按月更新。要更全面地了解我们的数据明细，请查看最新的{{11}}。要下载这些数据，请访问我们的{{12}}或使用{{13}}。
